model: RandomForestClassifier (sklearn, 500 trees, random_state=42), zeros in glucose/blood_pressure/skin_thickness/insulin/bmi treated as missing and median-imputed from train
notes: Stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42). followup_score excluded as likely leakage: it separates classes almost perfectly (~65 vs ~34); including it gives test accuracy ~0.927 but it is probably measured after diagnosis.
